workflow-item: Read and write an epic's tasks, notes and chains.
workflow-item epic-dispatch-chain: Manage the chains that hand out epic tasks.
workflow-item epic-dispatch-chain advanc: Move a chain to its next ready task.
workflow-item epic-dispatch-chain get: Show one dispatch chain and its current task.
workflow-item epic-dispatch-chain refres: Record that a chain started its current task.
workflow-item epic-dispatch-chain update: Change one field of a dispatch chain.
workflow-item epic-progress-note: Write and read epic task progress notes.
workflow-item epic-progress-note append: Add a progress note to an epic task.
workflow-item epic-progress-note list: List an epic task's progress notes.
workflow-item epic-task: Add, change and review the tasks of an epic.
workflow-item epic-task add: Add a task to an epic.
workflow-item epic-task history-insert: Record one epic task status change.
workflow-item epic-task metadata-update: Change an epic task's title, dependencies or limits.
workflow-item epic-task reassign: Move an epic task to another lane.
workflow-item epic-task remove: Remove a task from an epic.
workflow-item epic-task review-get: Show the latest review of an epic task.
workflow-item epic-task review-insert: Record a pass or fail review of an epic task.
workflow-item epic-task review-list: List the reviews of an epic task, newest first.
workflow-item epic-task review-seed: Require an implementation review for an epic task.
workflow-item epic-task scope-finalize: Close an epic's task list to new tasks.
workflow-item epic-task scope-reopen: Reopen an epic's task list for changes.
workflow-item epic-task simulation-get: Show the latest simulation report for an epic.
workflow-item epic-task simulation-upser: Save a simulation report for an epic.
workflow-item epic-task split: Split an epic task into smaller tasks.
workflow-item epic-task submission-recei: Check an epic task's latest work submission.
